source: local pi session logs (read-only, aggregated): session-end prompt = input + cache read + cache write of the last assistant call
method: quantiles by linear interpolation between order statistics (R-7); a session counts once, at its last call

throughput.source: local pi session logs (read-only, aggregated): all four token classes of every assistant call, per session and clock hour (UTC)
throughput.method: session-hour = one session with usage in one clock hour; aggregate = all tokens / session-hours; median, mean and p90 are over session-hours (R-7); concurrency = distinct sessions per clock hour that has usage
